items.title: Attach the detail, not just the photo
items.idea: A photo becomes useful when the exact point and its context travel with it.
beats: Open the camera from a question about the mounting point.
Capture the room, then pin the exact ceiling point.
The annotated photo collapses into the conversation with its note.

items.title: Ask for the missing angle
items.idea: The assistant asks for one missing piece of evidence instead of making a guess.
beats: Two photos are attached, but the threshold is missing.
The missing slot opens the photo library; one angle is selected.
The evidence set completes and the next question becomes precise.

items.title: Bring back the reason
items.idea: Recall the decision and its reason, not merely the last image.
beats: Ask why the warm-white finish was chosen.
Scrub a compact timeline from sample to approval.
The answer arrives with the exact source, date and decision owner.

items.title: Turn a spoken concern into a hold
items.idea: A site observation becomes one explicit unresolved action.
beats: Start a voice note beside the framing photo.
The spoken example resolves into highlighted room, issue and action.
A missing-blocking hold attaches to the spec, not a false approval.

items.title: Let the assumptions change the number
items.idea: Quantities stay trustworthy when their assumptions remain visible and editable.
beats: The plan shows the entered room dimensions.
Subtract a cabinet footprint and drag the waste allowance.
The box count updates with the formula still attached.

items.title: Compare the same detail
items.idea: Compare a material detail in place instead of mentally matching two distant images.
beats: Open the delivered sample against the approved reference.
Drag a wipe across the matching detail and zoom together.
Flag the difference for site-light review rather than claiming a measured color match.

items.title: Expose the cost outside the headline
items.idea: The useful price includes the lines hidden outside the headline figure.
beats: Attach a short supplier quote.
Freight and tax lift out of their source lines into the calculation.
The delivered total replaces the headline price without losing provenance.

items.title: Place it, then question the fit
items.idea: A room placement helps frame the next measured question; it is not installation approval.
beats: The room becomes the placement surface.
Drag a pendant over the table and adjust its drop.
A clearance callout keeps measured inputs separate from visual fit.

items.title: Move the date, reveal the consequence
items.idea: A delivery slip should visibly move the work that depends on it.
beats: The promised delivery and installer start appear on one calendar.
Drag delivery three days later.
The dependent start moves and an unconfirmed booking is flagged.

items.title: Change the object, keep the intent
items.idea: Inspect a substitute in three dimensions while preserving the original design constraints.
beats: Orbit the original pendant.
Swipe to the alternative while keeping orientation and scale.
The changed silhouette and unresolved specification checks stay visible together.

items.title: One approval cannot stand in for two
items.idea: Budget approval and trade suitability are different decisions.
beats: A single proceed action reveals two approval lanes.
The homeowner approves cost while the trade lane stays pending.
The purchase remains on hold until the second authority confirms.

items.title: Receive the exception, not just the boxes
items.idea: The receiving record should make shortages and damage impossible to miss.
beats: A delivery label maps to the expected order.
The count is entered one short and a damaged item is marked.
Only the exceptions become the follow-up record.

items.title: Give each trade the right layer
items.idea: One plan can produce a focused, revision-aware handoff for each trade.
beats: A crowded plan shows several trade layers.
Switch to framing and fade unrelated layers.
The selected revision and unresolved item travel into the handoff pack.

items.title: Let the evidence build the return
items.idea: A return draft should assemble around the damage evidence, not the other way around.
beats: Pair the damaged can with its delivery record.
Select the damage detail and confirm the affected quantity.
The evidence folds into a ready-to-review return draft, not a sent request.
